search.title: 2021–22 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team
search.snippet: The 2021–22 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team represented Louisiana Tech University during the 2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season.

search.title: Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball
search.snippet: The Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball program, nicknamed the Dunkin' Dogs, represents intercollegiate men's basketball at Louisiana Tech University.
